project.title: Customer Churn Prediction and Insights Dashboard
project.objective: Design, build, and validate a churn prediction model and self-service dashboard to help commercial teams reduce customer attrition.
deliverables: Documented churn problem definition and target metric
Clean, model-ready customer dataset with data dictionary
Production-ready churn prediction model with performance report
Interactive churn insights and segmentation dashboard
Playbook for commercial teams on using churn scores
Monitoring plan for model performance and data quality
constraints: All modelling must use only approved, anonymised customer data
Initial MVP model and dashboard needed within 21 days
Solutions must integrate with existing BI and data warehouse stack
Documentation must be understandable by non-technical stakeholders
Model decisions must be explainable for compliance and audit
Limit manual data preparation to repeatable, automated steps

risks.risk: Customer data is incomplete or inconsistent across systems.
risks.mitigation: Prioritise key sources, run data profiling early, define and implement minimum data quality rules.

risks.risk: Model is accurate but not trusted or adopted by commercial teams.
risks.mitigation: Involve business stakeholders in feature selection, provide clear explanations and use cases, run pilot with feedback loop.

risks.risk: Tight timeline leads to over-engineered model and delayed delivery.
risks.mitigation: Deliver a simple baseline model first, timebox experiments, and clearly separate MVP from nice-to-have features.

risks.risk: Regulatory or compliance concerns about using certain features.
risks.mitigation: Review feature list with compliance early, exclude sensitive attributes, document rationale for included variables.

risks.risk: Dashboard performance issues with large datasets.
risks.mitigation: Pre-aggregate key metrics, optimise queries, and validate performance with realistic data volumes.

themes.why_relevant: Reliable churn predictions depend on consistent, well-understood customer data from multiple systems.
The team must agree on target definition, features, algorithms, and performance thresholds.
Outputs must match how sales and customer success teams work to ensure real-world impact.
Stakeholders need transparent reasoning behind churn scores to satisfy governance requirements.
Insights must be presented clearly so non-technical users can act quickly on churn risks.

backlog.task: Define churn use case, target variable, and success metrics with business stakeholders
definition_of_done: Churn definition agreed and documented
Primary and secondary KPIs defined and approved
Scope of customers and time horizon clarified
Assumptions and out-of-scope items listed in a shared doc

backlog.task: Profile and assess quality of core customer and subscription data sources
definition_of_done: Key data sources and tables inventoried
Data quality report created with missingness and anomalies
Critical data issues prioritised and shared with team
Data dictionary draft created for core fields

backlog.task: Design and implement data preparation pipeline for churn modelling dataset
definition_of_done: Feature list and transformations documented
Reproducible scripts or queries created and versioned
Model-ready dataset generated and validated against source
Data preparation steps reviewed by data analyst

backlog.task: Develop baseline churn prediction model and benchmark performance
definition_of_done: Baseline model trained using agreed dataset
Train/validation split and evaluation methodology documented
Performance metrics computed and shared
Limitations and improvement ideas captured in model report

backlog.task: Iterate on model features and algorithms to improve performance and stability
definition_of_done: At least two alternative models evaluated
Feature importance and stability analysis completed
Selected model justified against baseline
Final model parameters and artefacts stored in repository

backlog.task: Define business-friendly segments and thresholds for churn risk levels
definition_of_done: Risk bands (e.g., low/medium/high) defined with score thresholds
Impact analysis for each band documented
Stakeholder review completed with sign-off
Segments mapped to recommended actions in playbook

backlog.task: Design and build churn insights dashboard for commercial teams
definition_of_done: Dashboard wireframe agreed with business stakeholders
Dashboard built in existing BI tool using model outputs
Key filters, segments, and drill-downs implemented
Usability tested with at least two end users and feedback applied

backlog.task: Document model, data lineage, and usage guidelines for compliance and audit
definition_of_done: Model documentation completed with methodology and assumptions
Data lineage from source to model outputs mapped
List of excluded sensitive features documented
Compliance officer review feedback addressed

backlog.task: Create churn playbook and training materials for sales and customer success
definition_of_done: Playbook drafted with scenarios and recommended actions
Screenshots and examples from dashboard included
Training session agenda and slides prepared
Pilot group feedback incorporated into final version

backlog.task: Set up monitoring for model performance and data drift
definition_of_done: Key monitoring metrics and thresholds defined
Monitoring queries or scripts implemented
Alerting process agreed with data platform owner
Monitoring plan documented and shared

backlog.task: Align project roadmap, milestones, and communication plan
definition_of_done: High-level roadmap with milestones created
Dependencies and owners identified for each milestone
Communication cadence agreed with stakeholders
Roadmap shared in channel and stored in project folder

backlog.task: Validate data refresh process and dashboard update schedule
definition_of_done: Data refresh frequency agreed with business
Test refresh run completed without errors
Dashboard reflects latest model scores after refresh
Update schedule documented in monitoring plan

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on churn definition, KPIs, and initial project scope.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the churn project and asking for agreement on problem framing.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the operational definition of churn and the prediction horizon.
Confirm primary KPIs to evaluate model and business impact.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review data inventory and decide on data sources and quality fixes.
threads_plan.trigger: Data analyst posts first version of data inventory and quality findings.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which customer and subscription data sources will be in scope for MVP.
Prioritise top data quality issues to fix before modelling.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Discuss baseline model results and choose the model to take forward.
threads_plan.trigger: Data scientist shares baseline and experiment results from the model log.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on minimum acceptable model performance thresholds for MVP.
Select the model version to integrate with the dashboard.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define churn risk bands, dashboard layout, and user journeys.
threads_plan.trigger: Business analyst posts proposal for risk segmentation and dashboard wireframes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve churn risk thresholds and segment definitions.
Sign off on dashboard layout and key views for first release.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Close out MVP, confirm monitoring plan, and plan training rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Approaching deadline, team reviews readiness for go-live and next steps.

channel_rituals: Async standup three times per week where each person posts yesterday/today/blockers.
Weekly modelling review to discuss experiment results and next hypotheses.
Bi-weekly stakeholder update summarising progress, risks, and upcoming milestones.
Pre-release checklist review before any major dashboard or model change goes live.
